definitions.pointsCost: Expected points the flag cost the penalized team (nflverse EPA model)
definitions.winProbCost: Win chances (percentage points) the flag cost the penalized team: the change in nflverse win probability when the flag erases the play; for a wiped-out touchdown, the chance had it stood (similar kickoffs since 2015, assuming the extra point) minus the chance after the play; otherwise the points cost times what a point is worth at that score and clock (measured since 2015)
definitions.winsGivenAway: Sum of win chances lost to flags, in wins
definitions.method: play value = the erased play's change in expected points; penalty yards = flag added on top of a play that counts, valued at ~0.06 points per yard; two-point retry = 2 x the 46.8% conversion rate
definitions.keyFirstDownsGiven: Defensive flags that gave the offense a first down on 3rd or 4th down
definitions.drivesKilled: Drives stalled: offensive flags inside the opponent 40 on drives that then did not score (the flag may or may not be why)
definitions.bigPlaysErased: Offensive flags that wiped out a 15+ yard gain or a touchdown
definitions.tdsErased: Touchdowns wiped out by the scoring team's own flag (including fouls enforced at the spot and offsetting fouls)
definitions.tdsLostOffsetting: Of those, touchdowns wiped out by offsetting fouls (both teams flagged; no yards enforced)
definitions.turnoversErased: Defensive flags that wiped out their own interception or fumble recovery

notes: Regular season, accepted penalties. Points and win chances are estimates from nflverse's expected-points and win-probability models and league rates since 2015.
